entities.summary: Die Weltwoche is a Swiss weekly magazine based in Zollikon, Canton of Zurich. Since 2006, it has been privately owned by Roger Köppel, a publicist, journalist and politician from the right-wing populist and conservative Swiss People's Party. Die Weltwoche is a newspaper in Zollikon, established in 1933. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
